Hóa học nghiên cứu các chất, sự biến đổi: Chemistry studies substances, their changes, and their applications in life.
Do not taste or smell chemicals directly.
Pour the acid slowly into the water when diluting.
Chất có ở khắp nơi và cấu tạo nên mọi vậ: Matter is everywhere and makes up all objects. Distinguish physical changes (dissolving, vaporization) from chemical reactions (forming new substances). Pure substances have constant physical and chemical properties.
